About

BEng (Hons) Electro-Mechanical Engineering, Oxford Brookes University 2021-2025. First class graduate. I am an electro-mechanical engineer with experience in embedded systems, robotics, and autonomous technology. My work combines engineering fundamentals with practical experimentation, from embedded hardware design to control systems and real-world prototyping. I enjoy building systems that are technically robust, efficient, and grounded in real applications.
